title: Hooves
description: Horse carriage ride-hailing on Mackinac Island. Hail a carriage from your phone.

hero.heading: Hooves
hero.tagline: Mackinac Island's horse carriage taxi service.
hero.tagline2: Hail a carriage from your phone — no cars, just hooves.

step1.title: Pick Your Stand
step1.description: Choose from 10 named pickup & dropoff locations across the island — the docks, Grand Hotel, Fort Mackinac, and more.

step2.title: A Carriage Comes to You
step2.description: Your nearest available driver accepts the ride. Track their carriage on a live map as they approach.

step3.title: Enjoy the Ride
step3.description: Sit back, take in the views, and arrive at your destination the way Mackinac was meant to be explored.

island.heading: The Only Way to Get Around
island.paragraph1: Mackinac Island has banned motor vehicles since 1898. Horse-drawn carriages are the island's taxis, buses, and delivery trucks — all rolled into one.
island.paragraph2: Hooves connects riders with licensed carriage drivers instantly. No flagging down a passing cab, no waiting at the dock hoping one shows up. Just open the app and ride.

forDrivers.heading: 🎠 Drive for Hooves
forDrivers.description: Licensed carriage operators — create a profile, go active when you're ready, and start accepting rides. Track your earnings, manage your schedule, all from one dashboard.
